subject.title: refactor: canonicalize correctness-critical UI and channel contracts

question: Should this maintainer-owned umbrella remain the canonical tracker while the linked Workboard and channel-status PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers split the remaining Control UI gateway work into narrower issues now?
rationale: The issue is protected by the maintainer label and spans security-sensitive status output plus package/protocol ownership boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent tracking or API shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through Staged PRs
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point until the Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then use it to drive the Control UI gateway slice.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Create narrower maintainer-owned issues for the remaining Control UI gateway contract work and close this issue only after the linked context is preserved there.

options.title: Pause Until PR Outcomes
options.body: Keep this issue open without new work-lane activity until maintainers decide whether the two open PRs establish the right seams.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through Staged PRs
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point until the Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then use it to drive the Control UI gateway slice.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the umbrella issue, its assignment, and both open implementation-candidate PRs.
